messages:
incident-bot: PAGER -> high severity: Dedicated pool 'cascade-health-prod' (tenant=cascade-health, VPC) reporting GPU exhaustion and queue growth. Alerts: gpu_util=95%, queued_requests=420, 503_count=182 in last 5m. Paging oncall-ryan.
oncall-ryan: On it. @sre-anya you able to pull live metrics /stack traces? Any customer-visible impact yet?
sre-anya: Checking dashboards. Confirming high gpu_util across pool, tail latency spiking. Tenant is dominating capacity (single-tenant). 503s correspond to request timeouts from workers after queue hit max_inflight. Current avg wait ~4.8s, 95th ~12s.
eng-runtime-marc: Likely sustained small-batch fanout from their orchestrator. Options: approve burst (reserve extra nodes), enable immediate model-fallback to quantized variant, or evict non-critical batch jobs. Burst will add capacity in ~3-6m if spare nodes available.
oncall-ryan: What's customer impact if we do fallback to smaller model? Any regression impact?
eng-runtime-marc: For text-generation endpoints we can flip tenant routing to gptq-small-8bit which reduces token throughput but maintains semantics for most prompts. Quality regressions minimal for short replies; noted for multi-turn long context. Suggest burst + fallback as safe combo.
acct-rep-lina: Cascade Health is on enterprise SLA, they expect 99.9. Approve a short burst window while we mitigate — they already notified support about errors. I'll notify account team and propose a 1h burst.
support-jess: Customer reports intermittent 503s on submit API: ~12% of requests failing earlier, now trending down slightly but still elevated. They are staging a call.
oncall-ryan: I'm going to request burst. Marcos, can you run the burst approve and route-switch steps? I'll stay in thread until handoff.
eng-runtime-marc: Running commands now: 
```
# approve 1h burst on dedicated pool
redwoodctl pools burst approve --pool cascade-health-prod --duration 60m --reason "tenant saturation - prod"
# switch tenant route to quantized fallback
redwoodctl routes set-fallback --tenant cascade-health --fallback-model gptq-small-8bit
```
eng-runtime-marc: burst approved (id=burst-2245). API shows new nodes allocating, expected ready ~4m. Fallback route applied.
incident-bot: Burst approved by marc (id=burst-2245). Pool state: scaling_up -> adding 4 nodes.
sre-anya: Starting eviction of non-critical background jobs for this tenant to free cache/GPU memory: `kubectl delete jobs -n tenant-cascade --selector=job-type=batch-noncritical` 
eng-runtime-marc: Also enabled prefix/KV cache eviction for tenant to free memory.
support-jess: After fallback and evictions errors dropping. 503s down to ~3% in last 6m; queued_requests 95.
oncall-ryan: Good. Lina please confirm customer informed and conference bridge started. I'm handing on-call to eng-runtime-marc for monitoring for the next 30m. If anything changes, page me back.
acct-rep-lina: On it — account call in 7m, telling them we approved capacity burst + temporary model fallback. Will offer rollback if they see quality issues.
eng-runtime-marc: Taking over on-call. I'll watch GPU util and queue. If burst nodes don't come up or queue remains >200, we'll consider emergency spill to us-west-2 or deny low-priority requests.
sre-anya: Adjusted autoscale policy: lower scale-up threshold from 90%->80% for this pool (temp, 2h window) to avoid delayed autoscale. Created ticket INC-2245 for policy revert.
incident-bot: Pool 'cascade-health-prod' status update: scaling_up=4_nodes_allocating, queue=92, gpu_util=78%, 503_rate=2.7%.
support-jess: Customer on call — they see degraded latencies but reduced errors. They want ETA to full recovery.
oncall-ryan: ETA ~10-12m for nodes to be fully in rotation and warm. If we still see issues after burst finished we'll plan a follow-up.
eng-runtime-marc: Nodes reporting ready. Rebalancing traffic across nodes now (rolling attach).
incident-bot: Pool status: active, nodes_added=4, queue=30, gpu_util=64%, 503_rate=0.6% -> Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring.
sre-anya: Leaving a few post-mortem notes in INC-2245: root cause likely tenant schedule + aggressive batch jobs causing KV cache pressure and preventing autoscale trigger. Suggest: tenant QoS limits for batch, autoscale smoothing tweaks, enforce tenant rate caps.
oncall-ryan: Thanks team. I’ll close the paging rotation and start handoff doc. Marc will own monitoring for the next 30m. Lina will coordinate customer follow-up + credit/SLAs. Jess please collect exact error samples and timestamps for the postmortem.
acct-rep-lina: Noted. Customer satisfied with immediate mitigation and agreed to temporary fallback. They'll monitor quality on their side.
eng-runtime-marc: Will keep watch and revert fallback after stabilization. planning to revert route in 45m if metrics stay stable. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident closed to pager (status: mitigated). Log: burst-2245 used, nodes_added=4, duration=56m.
oncall-ryan: Closing my rotation. Filing short postmortem in #postmortems and linking INC-2245. Great job everyone.
support-jess: Collected error logs and will upload to INC-2245.
sre-anya: :thumbsup:
